dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: The blood of outsiders does not mix with that of the tribe, so in many things, I tend to represent something of an "exception"...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: And since I've already been to lots of places that are "bad luck," they were fine with sending me to explore this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Aren't they just ostracizing you!?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Well, no... The tribe's just like that. They treat me very well, but I have an outsider's blood. That's all there is to it.
